record.question: Choose the correct statement on rules and regulation of element distribution
options: A minor element may substitute extensively for major elements if the difference in their ionic radii is not more than 25%.
Ions whose charges differ by one unit may not substitute for another even if their radii are similar and the charge difference can be compensated by another substitution.
LIL elements are more concentrated in mafic rather than felsic rocks because of their large radii and low electric charge.
The HFSE are concentrated in the felsic end of the series because their ionic size and higher charge make their substitution for any major ions in silicate minerals difficult.
